description: This Java class defines a factory for creating database sequence incrementers specific to different database types (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL). It supports configuration of the incrementer column name and provides methods to retrieve appropriate incrementers based on database type, and to check supported types.

classes.name: FineractDataFieldMaxValueIncrementerFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates database-specific max value incrementer objects, supporting MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL. It also allows configuration of the incrementer column name.

methods.name: setIncrementerColumnName
methods.description: Sets the name of the column used for incrementing IDs, with a default of 'ID'.

methods.name: getIncrementer
methods.description: Returns a DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer based on the specified incrementer type and name, suitable for supported database types.

methods.name: isSupportedIncrementerType
methods.description: Checks if a given incrementer type is supported by the factory.

methods.name: getSupportedIncrementerTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of strings representing the supported database types for incrementers.

methods.name: getDatabaseType
methods.description: Converts a string incrementer type into a DatabaseType enum.
